name: RAPTOR Hillaire-2020 atmosphere LUTs
reference: Hillaire, 'A Scalable and Production Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique', EGSR 2020

units.internal: kilometers (all LUT parameterizations, coefficients below given per km AND per m)
units.radiometric: sun irradiance = 1 per channel at top of atmosphere; game applies its own sun intensity + exposure

constants.ozone_profile: tent: density(h) = clamp(1 - abs(h_km - 25.0) / 15.0, 0, 1)  (zero at 10km and 40km, peak 1 at 25km)

phase_functions.convention: cos_theta = dot(sunDir, viewDir); sunDir points TOWARD the sun, viewDir along the view ray away from camera; forward-scatter peak at cos_theta = +1

transmittance_lut.axes: x (256) = view-zenith mapping x_mu; y (64) = altitude mapping x_r; PNG row 0 (top) = x_r ~ 0 (ground) -> texture.flipY = false
transmittance_lut.content: transmittance to the TOP of atmosphere along the ray (r, mu), rgb
transmittance_lut.encode: linear 16-bit split: value16 = round(T * 65535); *_msb.png = value16 >> 8, *_lsb.png = value16 & 255 (both 8-bit RGB PNG)
transmittance_lut.decode: T = (msb * 256 + lsb) / 65535   -- with unorm8 texture samples t_msb,t_lsb in [0,1]: T = t_msb*(65280/65535) + t_lsb*(255/65535). Recommended: decode once at load time (JS) into a single rgba16float texture.
transmittance_lut.sampling: bilinear, clamp-to-edge, uv computed by params_to_uv below (no sub-texel remap; bake evaluated at texel centers uv = (i+0.5)/256, (j+0.5)/64 through uv_to_params)
params_to_uv: d   = max(0, -r*mu + sqrt(r^2*(mu^2 - 1) + Rtop^2))   // distance to top boundary; discriminant always >= 0 for r <= Rtop
transmittance_lut.bake_integration: 4096 uniform midpoint samples of sigma_t along [0, d]; T = exp(-sum(sigma_t)*d/N)

multiscatter_lut.axes: x (32) = sun cos zenith mu_s in [-1,1]; y (32) = altitude in [0, Rtop-Rground]; PNG row 0 (top) = altitude 0 (ground) -> texture.flipY = false
multiscatter_lut.content: psi_ms (rgb): total multiple-scattered luminance transfer, Hillaire eq. 10: psi = L_2ndOrder / (1 - f_ms)
multiscatter_lut.encode: sqrt-encoded 16-bit split: e = sqrt(psi / 0.125); value16 = round(clamp(e,0,1) * 65535); split msb/lsb as transmittance
multiscatter_lut.decode: psi = ((msb*256 + lsb) / 65535)^2 * 0.125   -- decode at load time into a float texture; do NOT bilinear-filter the sqrt-encoded bytes directly
params_to_uv: unit.y = clamp(h_km / 100.0, 0, 1)     // altitude above ground / (Rtop - Rground)
uv = (unit * 31.0 + 0.5) / 32.0        // exact texel-center mapping: unit 0 -> texel 0 center, unit 1 -> texel 31 center
// NOTE: exact inverse pair; replaces Hillaire's approximate fromUnitToSubUvs/fromSubUvsToUnit
bake_params_at_texel: h    = (j / 31) * 100 km    // j = row 0..31; r clamped to [Rground+0.01, Rtop-0.01]
multiscatter_lut.usage: inside the sky/aerial raymarch, per sample at (P, h): S += psi_ms(mu_s, h) * (sigma_s_rayleigh + sigma_s_mie); psi already contains the isotropic phase and the infinite-bounce series
multiscatter_lut.bake_integration: 64 uniform sphere directions (theta = 2pi*(i+0.5)/8, phi = acos(1 - 2*(j+0.5)/8)), 40-step raymarch each, uniform phase 1/4pi, ground albedo 0.3 Lambertian bounce, sun transmittance from the (float, pre-quantization) transmittance LUT

raymarch_recipe.description: the reference (and the TSL port) march used for sky-view LUT / aerial perspective
steps: tBottom = raySphereNearest(pos, dir, Rground); tTop = raySphereNearest(pos, dir, Rtop)
tMax = tBottom >= 0 ? tBottom : tTop; aerial perspective: tMax = min(tMax, surfaceDistance)
dt = tMax / N; N = 32; sample at midpoints t_i = (i + 0.5) * dt
per sample: h = length(P) - Rground; sigma_s_ray/sigma_s_mie/sigma_t from medium()
mu_s = dot(normalize(P), sunDir); T_sun = transmittanceLUT(r, mu_s)
earthShadow = raySphereNearest(P, sunDir, Rground, center = 0.01 * normalize(P)) < 0 ? 1 : 0
S = earthShadow * T_sun * (sigma_s_ray * phaseR + sigma_s_mie * phaseM) + psi_ms(mu_s, h) * (sigma_s_ray + sigma_s_mie)
L += throughput * (S - S * exp(-sigma_t * dt)) / sigma_t      // guard sigma_t < 1e-12: use S * dt
raymarch_recipe.sky_output: L (rgb radiance, sun irradiance 1 at TOA); no ground albedo term, no sun disc
raymarch_recipe.aerial_output: transmittance = throughput (rgb), inscatter = L (rgb); apply in-material as color * transmittance + inscatter * sunIntensity

coordinate_convention_reference_api: y-up; planet center at (0, -Rground, 0) relative to a camera at altitude alt: internally pos = (0, Rground + alt_km, 0); sunDir/viewDir unit vectors, sun azimuth +z in the test vectors
